Bookmark this page for the latest news, rumblings and analysis from ESPN's insiders.</description><pubDate>Tue, 17 Nov 2026 18:01:37 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2025/0121/r1441247_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Pistons' Duncan Robinson (quad), Ron Holland II (knee) out vs. Spurs</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50512067/pistons-robinson-quad-holland-knee-tuesday-vs-spurs</link><description>The Pistons will be without guard Duncan Robinson and forward Ronald Holland II against the Spurs on Tuesday night because of injuries.</description><pubDate>Tue, 17 Nov 2026 18:04:53 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1117/r1747153_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>What the NBA's first month has revealed about all 30 teams</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50502518/first-month-lakers-knicks-spurs-celtics</link><description>With the season's first month nearly in the books, Ben Golliver examines the biggest storyline so far for all 30 teams.</description><pubDate>Tue, 17 Nov 2026 17:26:16 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1116/nba_30-teams_16x9.jpg" /></item><item><title>The clock is ticking on Steph Curry's final act with the Warriors</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50503111/steph-curry-warriors-race-injuries</link><description>At 38, Curry is still brilliant -- but managing his body has become the biggest battle of his career.</description><pubDate>Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:58:52 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1116/r1746718_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
